Aria (acct exec): Heads up — MedicusHealth signed the MSA and needs a compact DD packet for procurement by Fri. They want SOC2 excerpts, a signed external pen-test attestation, ISO scope note, and an itemized Dedicated delta including KMS/HSM options. Can we assemble?

Deep (solutions): We can stand up a staging tenant in us-west with static egress. I'll prepare a 1-page connectivity runbook and a presigned upload path. Any special diagram needed?

Amira (security): We'll provide: SOC2 executive summary (redacted), control-matrix excerpt, network diagram for hosted + single-tenant, and a pen-test attestation draft (external-scan). If they request internal evidence later that's extra. CMK onboarding adds ~48-72h.

Kai (pricing): Give me the Dedicated spec. If it's 2x A100 equiv, ~2TB RAM, 3mo commit I can draft an itemized CSV: monthly delta, setup fee, CMK onboarding fee, HSM add-on, and optional "audit support" hourly line.

Rachel (legal): I have the pen-test letter template. Once security finalizes wording and we receive the signed one-page PoC scope from MedicusHealth, I can route for an on-letterhead signature (ops-sign). Sign-off turnaround ~24 business hours.

artifact-bot: SOC2 exec summary path: https://redwood-secure/docs/soc2/exec-summary.txt (auth required)

Aria (acct exec): I'll ping MedicusHealth for the signed PoC scope now and tell procurement: bundle by Thu COB, signed pen-test letter by Fri if scope returned.

Deep (solutions): I'll post the runbook + sample curl test by Thu morning.

Amira (security): I'll assemble the ZIP (redacted artifacts + KMS checklist + IP allowlist) by Thu COB and post the draft attestation for legal to review.

Kai (pricing): Preliminary numbers I'll post Thu: estimate +$18k/mo, $6k setup, CMK $1.2k one-time, HSM +$2.5k/mo, audit-support $250/hr.

Aria (acct exec): Thanks everyone. I'll update MedicusHealth and loop back once they return the scope. :white_check_mark:
